text: Anything rather than have that child brought up in such practical paganism.” “Oh! I remember. Poor little Susan! I must go and see her; would you mind calling at the school?” “Not a bit. I am curious to see something of the teaching she is to receive.” They did not speak much more, but thridded their way through many a bosky dell, whose soft green influence could not charm away the shock and the pain in Margaret’s heart, caused by the recital of such cruelty; a recital too, the manner of which betrayed such utter want of imagination, and therefore of any sympathy with the suffering animal.
